data.title: KSrelief Distributes 1,250 Food Baskets to Families Most in Need in Yemen's Shabwa
data.content:
Shabwa, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 1,250 food baskets on Thursday to families most in need in Asilan District, Shabwa Governorate, Yemen, benefiting 8,050 individuals, as part of the emergency response project.
    The assistance is part of Saudi Arabia's ongoing humanitarian and relief projects and programs through KSrelief to support the Yemeni people and alleviate their suffering amid the current crisis.
    -- SPA
21:30 Local Time 18:30 GMT
